philippines.title: Grab, NCMF Region XI partner for easier, more credible halal food discovery
philippines.description:
Grab Philippines has partnered with the National Commission on Muslim Filipinos (NCMF) Region XI, to make halal food discovery easier and more accurate for consumers when ordering food online. Piloted in Davao city, this collaborative initiative equips the Grab app with enhanced search and filtering features, allowing consumers to confidently identify halal-certified and Muslim-owned restaurants that align with their dietary needs.  The partnership was formalized through a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) signing on September 9 at Bajada Suites in Davao City, bringing together key stakeholders from the Consulate Office of Malaysia, the City Government of Davao, NCMF Region XI, and Grab […]...

philippines.title: Marcos heads to New Delhi to attend BRICS Summit
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday evening left for New Delhi, India, to attend the 18th BRICS Summit, bringing with him a vow to amplify the Association of Southeast Asian Nations’ (Asean) outlook on pressing global issues. Marcos departed Villamor Air Base in Pasay City at 7:50 p.m., accompanied by First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, Foreign Affairs Secretary Maria Teresa Lazaro, Information and Communications Technology Secretary Henry Aguda, and Finance Secretary Frederick Go. philippines.description:
Dr. Maria Rita Dacanay-Lucas has become the first awardee from the field of Professional Teachers to receive the Eric C. She is the dean of CEU’s School of Education, Liberal Arts, Music, and Social Work (SELAMS). The Eric C. Nubla Excellence Award is conferred on the most notable among the PRC Outstanding Professionals of the Year awardees, representing various fields.
